label: EV_CHARGER
definition: Installation or material alteration of electric vehicle charging equipment
include_examples: EVSE; Level 2 charger; vehicle charging station
exclude_examples: Parking electrical work without charging equipment

label: BATTERY_STORAGE
definition: Stationary electrical energy storage equipment
include_examples: Battery energy storage system; ESS; Powerwall
exclude_examples: Ordinary batteries in alarms or vehicles

label: SOLAR_PV
definition: Photovoltaic solar electric generation equipment
include_examples: PV modules; photovoltaic array; solar electric
exclude_examples: Solar thermal only; generic electrical permit

label: GAS
definition: Fuel gas piping meters or gas-fired equipment connections
include_examples: Gas piping; gas meter; fuel gas
exclude_examples: Water piping; gasoline storage

label: SIGN
definition: Installation alteration or removal of signs and associated sign structures
include_examples: Wall sign; monument sign; illuminated sign
exclude_examples: Traffic signs; contract signatures

label: ALTERATION_REMODEL
definition: Alteration renovation or remodel of an existing building
include_examples: Interior renovation; tenant alteration
exclude_examples: New standalone building with no alteration scope

label: ROOFING
definition: Roof covering replacement repair or new roof work
include_examples: Reroof; shingles; membrane roof
exclude_examples: Roof-mounted equipment with no roofing scope

label: WATER_HEATER
definition: Installation or replacement of water-heating equipment
include_examples: Water heater; tankless heater; heat-pump water heater
exclude_examples: Space-heating boiler without domestic hot water scope

label: WINDOW_DOOR
definition: Installation replacement or alteration of windows doors or glazing
include_examples: Window replacement; storefront glazing; exterior door
exclude_examples: Framing with no window door or glazing work

label: FENCE_WALL
definition: Construction alteration or replacement of fences or freestanding walls
include_examples: Fence; retaining wall; masonry wall
exclude_examples: Interior partition wall

label: HEAT_PUMP
definition: Installation or replacement of heat-pump equipment
include_examples: Air-source heat pump; mini-split heat pump
exclude_examples: Generic HVAC; heat-pump water heater when only domestic water heating

label: PLUMBING
definition: General plumbing fixtures water supply drainage or piping work
include_examples: Plumbing permit; fixtures; water piping
exclude_examples: Fuel gas only; sewer utility main only

label: NEW_CONSTRUCTION
definition: Construction of a new principal building or structure
include_examples: New building; new residence
exclude_examples: Addition or accessory structure only

label: DEMOLITION
definition: Full or partial demolition of a building structure or interior
include_examples: Total demolition; selective demolition
exclude_examples: Removal of one fixture with no demolition scope

label: MECHANICAL_HVAC
definition: General mechanical heating ventilation cooling or refrigeration work
include_examples: HVAC; air conditioning; ductwork
exclude_examples: Heat pump when the narrower label is supported

label: FIRE_PROTECTION
definition: Fire alarm sprinkler suppression or related detection systems
include_examples: Fire sprinkler; fire alarm; hood suppression
exclude_examples: Lawn irrigation sprinkler

label: DECK_PATIO_PORCH
definition: Construction repair or alteration of decks patios or porches
include_examples: Deck; patio; porch
exclude_examples: Interior floor platform

label: DRIVEWAY_PAVING
definition: Driveway sidewalk paving or hardscape work
include_examples: Driveway approach; asphalt paving; sidewalk
exclude_examples: Roof paving products

label: GRADING_SITEWORK
definition: Earthwork excavation grading erosion control or general site preparation
include_examples: Grading; excavation; site preparation
exclude_examples: Interior renovation

label: GARAGE_ACCESSORY
definition: Garage carport shed ADU or other accessory structure
include_examples: Detached garage; shed; accessory dwelling unit
exclude_examples: Principal new building

label: STRUCTURAL
definition: Structural framing foundation reinforcement or load-bearing work
include_examples: Foundation repair; structural framing; seismic retrofit
exclude_examples: Nonstructural finish work

label: POOL_SPA
definition: Swimming pool spa hot tub or associated pool equipment
include_examples: Pool; spa; hot tub
exclude_examples: Decorative fountain without recreational pool scope

label: ELECTRICAL
definition: General electrical wiring circuits service fixtures or equipment work
include_examples: Electrical permit; wiring; circuits
exclude_examples: Narrow solar EV charger or panel upgrade when specifically supported

label: SEWER_UTILITY
definition: Sewer water utility service main lateral or right-of-way utility connection
include_examples: Sewer lateral; water service; utility main
exclude_examples: Interior plumbing fixtures

label: ELECTRICAL_PANEL_UPGRADE
definition: Replacement upgrade or capacity change of electrical service panel or meter-main
include_examples: Panel replacement; 100A to 200A service; meter-main upgrade
exclude_examples: Reconnect or inspection only with no replacement or capacity change
